title: Count Vowels in a String
description: Count the number of vowels present in a string.
code:
text = input("Enter a sentence: ")
vowels = "aeiouAEIOU"
count = 0

for ch in text:
    if ch in vowels:
        count += 1

print("Number of vowels:", count)
expectedOutput: Enter a sentence: Number of vowels: 5
